newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Jardine to sell three affiliates.
newsitem.headline: Jardine to sell three affiliates.

text.p: Philippines' Jardine Davies Inc said on Friday its board had approved a plan to dispose its entire equity holdings in three of its affiliates.

Corporate secretary B.S. Chungunco told the Philipine Stock Exchange that the company planned to sell 75,000 shares in Thorn Lighting (Philippines) Inc, where it holds a 50 percent equity stake; 140,000 shares in Jardine Wines and Spirits Philippines Inc, where it holds 40 percent, and 300,000 shares in Jardine Aboitiz Insurance Brokers Inc, where it holds 27.5 percent.
Chungunco did not say how much the company is expected to generate from the sale, but said the disposition will be finalised within the year.

He said the plan is part of its corporate restructuring. Jardine has interests in securities broking, life insurance, shipping, manufacturing and distribution of cement, refractories and timber. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
